entries.title: Settings warns when nothing answers your project's batch check
entries.body: When you choose batched pull requests, the app reads your project's workflows on GitHub. If none of them mentions the batch check, Settings, Projects says so under Where changes go. A merge waiting for the batch check says the same on its note. If a check that answered before stays quiet for two hours after you approve, the note says that too, and your approval is kept.

picture.alt: Under Where changes go, with batched pull requests chosen, an orange line says no workflow in this project mentions its batch check yet
